answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 2 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in bridge, checked in atlas, and basalt shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 1325 identities would post 4781 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
